scientific_judgments.verdict: pass; explicit source-bound scientific interpretation accepted
scientific_judgments.reason: The first completed recharge reverses the signs on the same plates. In ideal LC motion, with the initially charged capacitor and zero current as the phase origin, q(t)=q_m cos(omega t) and current is proportional to sin(omega t), up to the chosen current orientation. At half a period q=-q_m and i=0; at a full period q=q_m and i=0. Equal electric/magnetic energies at half a period do not imply the same signed charge/current state. Both modern languages correctly reject a complete state return after only the first opposite-polarity recharge and preserve the source's complete-cycle recurrence and no-loss condition.
scientific_judgments.source_contrast: Fresh p0052#3 retains the literal sentence that recharging returns the initial state. The modern wording intentionally qualifies that ambiguous sentence in light of the adjacent recharge sequence; it is not a literal translation of that sentence. This distinction was reviewed directly and is scientifically justified.
scientific_judgments.binding_and_erratum_boundary: The fresh source text and bindings stay unchanged. No equation, digit, sign, or registered mathematical erratum is altered. Acceptance here is of this explicit prose interpretation, not approval to repair the raw source.

scientific_judgments.reason: Both modern languages require an uncharged capacitor AND no circuit current for equilibrium. That is q=i=0. They do not mistake the later q=0, nonzero-current crossing for equilibrium. Battery charging establishes electric energy and the initial displacement from equilibrium.

The definition opposes change of current, not current itself. During growth the induced circulating electric field opposes the current; during decay it supports continuing current. In the loss-free LC sequence, q=0 gives zero capacitor voltage and zero coil voltage at the current extremum, not over the subsequent recharge interval. Chinese says 'this moment' through its preceding 'this time' linkage; English explicitly says 'at this moment'. Neither language says a zero voltage continuously maintains the current.
scientific_judgments.limit: The ideal-sequence statements are read under the explicit preceding no-loss assumption. With finite R, the pure inductive voltage and current-maximum timing cannot simply be identified with q=0; no such extension is approved.

scientific_judgments.reason: E is capacitor electric-field energy; K is coil magnetic-field energy, not kinetic energy. q_m, U_m and I_m denote maxima; q and i are instantaneous quantities; C, L and R are capacitance, self-inductance and resistance. Complete transfer at q=0 and repeatable energy maxima are explicitly qualified by ignoring losses. The final block retains resistance in coil/wires, conversion to internal energy, heating, and decay of real free oscillations. The modern additions do not imply sustained real oscillations without external power.

Both editions describe the source's cathode-ray apparatus, not all present-day oscilloscopes. Horizontal sawtooth sweep u_p has the slow rise, fast fall/return and repeated scan; capacitor voltage drives vertical deflection, producing a time trace. The moving-paper/hourglass-pendulum analogy, decreasing amplitude, marker ① and separate source-bound footnote survive. Fraction-of-a-second decay is scoped to this circuit; longer phosphor persistence is an observation aid, not a means of reducing circuit damping.

Both languages identify an outside periodically varying EMF and a rotating multi-turn coil frame in a uniform field. Flux variation, induction, magnetic force on charges moving with the conductor, a closed circuit and galvanometer motion remain faithful. The rotating assembly is the stated driving source; no sentence says the stationary magnetic field supplies energy or that the magnetic force performs net work on a charge. Physically, maintaining rotation against electrical loading supplies mechanical work converted to electrical energy. The added per-unit-charge definition of EMF is consistent with that account, and correctly says EMF is not a mechanical force.
scientific_judgments.scope_note: Mechanical input is implicit in the existing rotating-source description rather than a new explicit energy-budget paragraph. This is not a source-completeness defect; the source does not contain such a paragraph either.

Contact 2, capacitor discharge, current appearance and gradual rather than instantaneous growth all survive.
Self-induction opposes current change, and the changing current creates the changing magnetic field; the added definition is correct.
Induced circulating electric field, source ninth-grade reference and opposition during increasing field are retained. Modern 'rapid' wording preserves fresh source 急遽.
During discharge, electric-field energy decreases as magnetic-field energy grows; complete bilingual correspondence.
Displayed K=Li^2/2 and equation number (2.2) are source-exact.
K explicitly means magnetic energy, i instantaneous current and L self-inductance; no kinetic-energy substitution or symbol drift.
q, exact q=0 and zero electric energy survive; complete magnetic storage is explicitly conditional on ignoring energy losses.
Magnetic/current maxima, I_m and Figure 29a are retained under the preceding ideal assumption. English and Chinese maximum-subscript glosses agree.
Zero coil voltage belongs to this instant in the ideal sequence, not a lasting interval. Current cannot jump to zero; self-induction opposes both growth and decrease.
When current/field start weakening, the induced electric field supports the continuing current; this is not described as resistance-free driving by zero voltage.
Continuing current recharges the capacitor to opposite plate polarity before current reaches zero; the added polarity explanation is scientifically necessary and correct.
Zero magnetic energy at zero current and return to maximum electric energy are retained with an explicit no-loss condition; field-to-field exchange is correct.
The first reverse-polarity recharge is explicitly not full state restoration. Next discharge and original-polarity recharge correctly complete the sequence.
Undamped persistence requires no losses. Half-period reversed polarity is distinguished from full-period recurrence of signed charge/current; both languages are equivalent.
Real losses, coil/wire resistance and exact R survive; the resistance gloss is correct.
Electromagnetic energy becomes internal energy/heating, leaving less exchange energy and causing decay of real free oscillations; complete bilingual correspondence.
